get.description: This endpoint returns USD price histories and current USD price of given asset of the given period.

parameters.name: end_datetime
parameters.description: End datetime for histories (timezone: UTC, format: %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z). Default is now.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period can be hour, date, week and month. If hour is set the start time is set 2 weeks ago, otherwise 1 year. Default is date.

parameters.name: start_datetime
parameters.description: Start datetime for histories (timezone: UTC, format: %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z). Default is max of 1 year ago / Asset creation datetime.

get.description: This endpoint returns a dictionary with ASA IDs as the keys (e.g. `<ASA_1>`, `<ASA_2>`, ... , `<ASA_N>`) and AssetPrice objects as the values. In this calculation, the ratio of assets in the same pools used and assumed that the value of the USDC is equal to 1$.The response also contains the liquidity assets (pool tokens). The price of the liquidity assets are calculated using the pool reserves (Pool TVL / issued liquidity token amount).

get.description:

This API is developed according to Ideal API Endpoint (AMM DEXes, Section C) recommendations of CoinMarketCap.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1S4urpzUnO2t7DmS_1dc4EL4tgnnbTObPYXvDeBnukCg

This API is developed according to CoinGecko Integration API Standards.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v27QFoQq1SKT3Priq3aqPgB70Xd_PnDzbOCiuoCyixw

This response includes both V1 and V2 Pools
